channel.title: Midnight blog - Last 30 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Range: Last 30 days

item.title: Deploying a Hexo + Midnight Blog: Build from Source or Publish Static Files?
item.description: A maintainable Hexo + Midnight blog depends on separating source, the public build, hosting, and DNS. Compare Vercel source builds with a separate static-artifact repository, then verify the release boundary.

item.title: CODEOWNERS rules do not accumulate: the last matching line changes the reviewers
item.description: GitHub CODEOWNERS assigns reviewers by path pattern, with the last matching rule taking precedence. Put multiple optional owners for one pattern on the same line, and remember that a pull request uses the target branch's version.

item.title: Why is an S3 multipart ETag not the MD5 of the whole file?
item.description: An S3 multipart ETag identifies a completed object but is not guaranteed to be the whole-file MD5. Choose a checksum algorithm and full/composite type when initiating the upload, then validate the stored checksum on completion and retrieval.

item.title: A GitHub Environment can delay deployment secrets, but only when the job references it
item.description: A GitHub Actions job that references an environment must pass its protection rules before it can run or access that environment's secrets. Repository visibility and plan affect which rules are available.

item.title: Why has AbortSignal.timeout not expired after a page was suspended?
item.description: AbortSignal.timeout measures active time, not simply wall-clock time. Its clock pauses while a document is in the back-forward cache or a Worker is suspended, so it is not an absolute server-side deadline.

item.title: SQS heartbeats can reduce premature redelivery, but the 12-hour limit does not reset
item.description: An SQS visibility timeout is a lease-like way to hide a message temporarily, not a processing lock. Renewals remain subject to a 12-hour ceiling from the first ReceiveMessage, so consumers must plan for duplicate delivery and delayed retries.

item.title: SQS FIFO's five-minute deduplication protects send retries, not business side effects
item.description: Amazon SQS FIFO uses a message deduplication ID to prevent duplicate enqueueing within a five-minute window. It does not make a consumer's charge or database write happen once, and content hashing excludes message attributes.

item.title: Python audit hooks can log and abort events, but they cannot sandbox the interpreter
item.description: Python 3.12's sys.addaudithook is intended for runtime auditing. An existing hook can prevent a new hook from being installed without an explicit error, so the security boundary still belongs outside the interpreter.

item.title: Node.js permissions can limit a process, but they are not a sandbox for hostile code
item.description: Node.js 22's --permission can reduce accidental access to files, child processes, and Workers in trusted programs. The official documentation explicitly says it is not a security boundary against malicious code.

item.title: 页面挂起后 AbortSignal.timeout 为什么还没超时？
item.description: AbortSignal.timeout 使用活动时间而不是简单墙上时钟；文档进入 BFCache 或 Worker 挂起时计时会暂停，不能把它当作服务器端绝对期限。

item.title: CMake 生成表达式写对了语法，为什么仍没有展开？
item.description: Generator expression 在生成阶段、且只在支持它的属性或命令上下文中求值；命令参数解析早于求值，含分号或空格时还要先正确引用。

item.title: Docker 构建缓存有了 mount，为什么 CI 每次还是重新下载？
item.description: BuildKit cache mount 是构建器本地的可回收性能缓存，不写入镜像层，也不随 --cache-to 导出；CI 新建 builder 时可能为空，构建不能依赖其内容正确性。

item.title: EventBridge 目标不可用，默认重试为何五分钟后停止？
item.description: EventBridge 对目标投递在达到最大尝试次数或事件年龄上限时先停止；DLQ 要显式配置，重试成功也不等于业务副作用只发生一次。

item.title: CODEOWNERS 规则不是累加的，最后一个匹配行会改变审查人
item.description: GitHub CODEOWNERS 按路径匹配并由最后匹配规则决定 owner；同一模式的多个审核人必须写在同一行，且 PR 使用目标分支版本。

item.title: GitHub Environment 能推迟部署密钥访问，但前提是作业真正引用它
item.description: GitHub Actions 作业引用 environment 后，先通过该环境保护规则才能运行并访问其 secrets；仓库可见性和套餐会影响可用规则。

item.title: CRD YAML 提交成功，字段却消失：先检查结构化 schema 的裁剪
item.description: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 的 CRD 需要结构化 schema；未声明字段默认可能在 API server 持久化前被裁剪，保留未知子树必须显式设计并测试。

item.title: kubectl debug 能往运行中的 Pod 加容器，为什么还要单独授权？
item.description: Kubernetes ephemeral container 通过 pods/ephemeralcontainers 子资源加入既有 Pod；能 patch Pod 并不必然等于能执行这个诊断操作。

item.title: Server-Side Apply 冲突说明字段有人负责，不等于配置无法更新
item.description: Kubernetes SSA 按字段记录 manager；改动他人管理且值不同的字段会冲突，强制覆盖会转移所有权。先厘清控制器与发布工具的职责，再决定是否 force。

item.title: Node.js 权限模型能收紧进程权限，但不是运行陌生代码的沙箱
item.description: Node.js 22 的 --permission 适合减少可信程序误用文件、子进程和 Worker 的机会；官方明确不把它当作抵御恶意代码的安全边界。

item.title: Node 测试里的时钟被推进了，为什么 Promise 还没完成？
item.description: Node test runner 的 MockTimers 推进虚拟 timer/Date 时钟，但 setTime、tick 和 Promise 微任务不是一个概念；先明确要驱动哪种等待。

item.title: 指标图上看到尖峰，却找不到请求：OpenTelemetry exemplar 连接了什么？
item.description: Exemplar 是附在指标数据点上的一次代表性观测，可带 trace_id 和 span_id 帮助从聚合指标跳到 trace；它不增加每个请求都要存储的 span。

item.title: Python audit hook 能记录和中止事件，但不能把解释器变成沙箱
item.description: Python 3.12 的 sys.addaudithook 面向运行时审计；钩子安装本身可能被已有钩子拒绝且不显式报出，安全边界仍须放在解释器之外。

item.title: Redis WAIT 返回 2，为什么仍不能说写入已经耐久？
item.description: WAIT 等待当前连接此前写命令被指定数量的副本确认；调用方必须核对返回数。它提高故障安全概率，但不提供强一致或独立持久化保证。

item.title: S3 分段上传返回的 ETag 为什么不能当成整文件 MD5？
item.description: S3 multipart ETag 标识组合对象，却不保证等于整文件 MD5；应在创建上传时选择 checksum 算法与 full/composite 类型，再按存储的校验值验证完整性。

item.title: 版本化 S3 对象 DELETE 返回成功，为什么旧文件还在？
item.description: 启用版本控制的 S3 桶中，不带 versionId 的 DELETE 通常创建 delete marker，让对象表现为已删除；恢复要精确移除当前 marker，永久删除旧版本则是另一项操作。

item.title: SQS FIFO 的五分钟去重保护的是发送重试，不是业务副作用
item.description: Amazon SQS FIFO 按消息去重 ID 在五分钟窗口内避免重复入队；它不替消费者保证一次性扣款或数据库写入，内容哈希也不包含消息属性。

item.title: SQS 心跳续租能减少抢重消息，但十二小时上限不会重置
item.description: SQS visibility timeout 是暂时隐藏消息的租约式机制，不是处理锁；续租仍受首次 ReceiveMessage 后十二小时上限约束，消费者要为重复投递和慢重试设计。

item.title: Terraform for_each 改了 map key，为什么计划要重建云资源？
item.description: for_each 的 key 成为 Terraform resource address 的实例身份；改 key 默认表示旧实例离开、新实例出现，需用 moved block 或 state mv 表达重命名。

item.title: TypeScript `satisfies` 能检查配置，却不把它抹成宽泛接口
item.description: `satisfies` 在保持表达式推断结果的同时检查它是否符合目标类型；它可发现缺键或错值类型，却不是运行时验证，也不绕过字面量推断规则。

item.title: The CMake generator expression is valid, so why did it not expand?
item.description: Generator expressions are evaluated during generation and only in supported properties or command contexts. Command-argument parsing happens first, so quoting may matter.

item.title: Why does CI still download dependencies after adding a Docker cache mount?
item.description: A BuildKit cache mount is reclaimable builder-local performance state, not an image layer or an exported --cache-to cache. A fresh CI builder may start empty.

item.title: Why does an EventBridge target stop retrying after five minutes by default?
item.description: EventBridge stops delivery when either the retry-attempt or event-age limit is reached. A DLQ must be configured explicitly, and a successful retry does not guarantee exactly-once side effects.

item.title: A CRD apply succeeds but a field disappears: check schema pruning first
item.description: A structural OpenAPI schema defines what a CRD persists. Unknown fields may be pruned before storage unless a specific subtree explicitly preserves them.

item.title: Why does kubectl debug need separate permission to add a container to a running Pod?
item.description: Kubernetes adds an ephemeral container through the pods/ephemeralcontainers subresource. Permission to patch a Pod does not automatically grant this diagnostic capability.

item.title: A Server-Side Apply conflict says a field has an owner, not that it can never change
item.description: SSA records field managers. A conflicting value is rejected, while force transfers ownership; first clarify controller responsibilities before using force-conflicts.

item.title: The test clock moved forward, so why is the Promise still pending?
item.description: Node's test-runner MockTimers controls selected timer and Date APIs, but setTime, tick, and Promise microtasks are distinct. Decide which wait your test must drive.

item.title: A metric chart shows a spike but no request: what does an OpenTelemetry exemplar connect?
item.description: An exemplar attaches a selected measurement to a metric point and can carry trace and span IDs. It helps jump from an aggregate to a trace without storing a span for every request.

item.title: Redis WAIT returned 2; why is the write still not necessarily durable?
item.description: WAIT checks replica acknowledgments for earlier writes on the current connection. The caller must check the returned count; this improves safety but does not guarantee strong consistency or persistence.

item.title: Why is the old file still there after DELETE succeeded in a versioned S3 bucket?
item.description: In a versioned S3 bucket, DELETE without versionId usually creates a delete marker. Recovery removes that exact marker; permanently deleting old versions is a separate operation.

item.title: Why does changing a Terraform for_each key plan to replace a cloud resource?
item.description: A for_each key becomes part of a Terraform resource address. Renaming it can look like one instance was removed and another added; use a moved block or state mv for a deliberate rename.

item.title: TypeScript `satisfies` checks a config without widening it to a broad interface
item.description: `satisfies` checks compatibility while preserving the expression's inferred result. It catches missing keys and bad value types, but is neither runtime validation nor an escape from inference rules.

item.description: 固定ASCII目标串比较三种本地输入，区分目标URI与正文容量，并说明重复414需要哪些响应来源证据。

item.title: JSON reviver 为什么先处理子字段，再把对象交给父回调？
item.description: 以完整回调轨迹和父层快照解释reviver后序处理，区分返回当前值、删除字段与数组索引留下缺项。

item.title: String.raw 里插入换行，为什么结果仍有真正的换行？
item.description: 用完整代码单元序列区分模板固定段与已求值插值，检查raw保留了什么，以及缺少替换值时如何连接。

item.description: 逐代码单元对照两个孤立代理与一个正确代理对，说明FFFD替换不可恢复原字符，并检查URI编码消费者的新条件。

item.description: 把暂停期间的模板修改与恢复后的发布身份分开核对；集群示例未运行。

item.description: Inspect lone and paired UTF-16 surrogates by exact units, distinguish replacement from recovery, and test a new URI-encoding consumer.

item.description: Restore scoped patches before teardown and verify normal, exceptional, and nested-owner behavior.

item.title: Why does ^ still use the original string origin in a fullmatch window?
item.description: Check original spans, sliced spans and real-newline controls to distinguish bounded matching from a new string origin.

item.description: Separate global capture, restoration and explicit streams with a controlled joined worker and an independent stderr check.

item.description: Separate caseless matching from original-text highlighting using expansion, offset and canonical-composition controls.
